_howto: Edit this file to change the title screen message (motd) or add a changelog entry. Newest entry first. Each entry: version, date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, changes (short bullet points, player-facing). The game fetches this file fresh on every launch.
motd: Phase 5 is here: Victory Road, the Elite Four, Champion Wren, the credits, and a brand-new soundtrack!

changelog.title: Smoother Walking and Box Healing
changes: Walking and running should be much smoother, especially on phones: the screen no longer repaints fully every frame
The day and night lighting is lighter on your device
Pokémon in the PC Box are now fully healed, including ones sent there when caught

changelog.title: In-Game Clock
changes: Day and night now run on your playtime instead of the real clock: each time of day lasts 30 minutes of play, so a full day is 2 hours
A new game starts in the morning, then day, evening and night

changelog.title: Day and Night
changes: Vellorin now follows your device's clock: morning (4 AM-10 AM), day (10 AM-5 PM), evening (5 PM-8 PM) and night (8 PM-4 AM)
The overworld lights up and darkens with the time of day. The area name shows the time as you arrive

Each time of day favours different types in the wild: morning Grass, Bug, Normal and Flying; day Fire, Ground, Rock, Fighting and Steel; evening Water, Electric, Psychic, Dragon and Ice; night Dark, Ghost, Fairy and Poison
At night, Dark, Ghost and Fairy Pokémon sometimes wander into areas they don't normally live in

changelog.title: Weather Amount
changes: OPTION > WEATHER now has OFF, LOW, MED and HIGH. LOW is the default and the look you had before
MED and HIGH add more rain, snow, ash and bubbles
OFF still keeps puddles, snow on the ground and ash on the grass

changelog.title: Weather Option
changes: New OPTION: WEATHER ON/OFF turns falling rain, snow, ash and bubbles on or off
With WEATHER off, the places still look the part: puddles, snow on the ground, ash on the grass and footprints all stay

changelog.title: Weather You Can Walk Through
changes: Rain: the ground looks wet, puddles ripple, and your steps splash
Snow: drifts on the grass, snow on the trees, and footprints behind you that slowly fade
Ash: grey ash settles on the grass and trees around Cindergate; walking through the grass kicks it up and leaves a clear trail
Underwater: the kelp sways

changelog.title: Elite Four Themes and Weather
changes: Each of the Elite Four now has their own battle theme, and Champion Wren has theirs
Rain, snow and underwater bubbles now fall and rise as loose drops, flakes and bubbles of different sizes, not a flat pattern

changelog.title: Gym Themes and Polish
changes: Every Gym Leader now has their own battle theme: fire, water, ground, ghost, electric, grass, ice and dragon
Gym trainers are now a warm-up for their Leader: smaller teams, a little lower level
The music pauses while you use the PC or the Nurse heals your team
Cindergate's ash now falls as drifting flakes instead of a flat haze

changelog.title: Fixes
changes: If a foe faints before your Pokémon attacks, the attack now goes to the next foe instead of being wasted
Numbers are easier to read: a 5 no longer looks like an S

changelog.title: League Balance and New Medicine
changes: New in Poké Marts: HYPER POTION and REVIVE from your 5th badge, FULL RESTORE with all 8
Victory Road and the late areas can hold Hyper Potions and Revives
The Elite Four and Champion Wren are a little easier
Fixed: key items and HMs showed up in the Mart's SELL list (selling one broke your money)

changelog.title: Phase 5: The Pokémon League
changes: With all 8 badges, take Victory Road from Aeriepeak City. Ace Trainers train in its caves
The Pokémon League: beat the Elite Four (Morrow, Brakk, Ferrin and Aurelle) back to back, then face Champion Wren
Black out in the League and you start again from the first room
Become Champion to enter the Hall of Fame and see the credits
Music! An original chiptune soundtrack with themes for towns, routes, the sea, caves, the deep, battles, Gym Leaders, the Champion and legendaries
New OPTION: MUSIC volume (OFF, LOW, MID, HIGH)

changelog.title: Phase 4: Dive
changes: Beat Leader Hale in Rimefall Town for HM08 DIVE
Look for dark, deep water while you SURF on the Stormwake Strait or the Glimmer Sea, and press A to dive
A whole underwater world: Stormwake Depths, the Coral Trench and Glimmer Deep, with kelp to search for underwater Pokémon
Swim into a shaft of light and press A to surface
The Sunken Shrine: Wren joins you, Admin Vesper makes her last stand, and the guardian Lugia awakens. Catch it if you can!
Beating Vesper ends the storms over Vellorin

changelog.title: Smoother Running
changes: Fixed: running could stutter every few steps, especially on phones. The world now redraws only the edge coming into view instead of the whole screen

changelog.title: Balance: Rivals and Gym Leaders
changes: Rival and Gym Leader teams now grow with your badges: 2 Pokémon at the start, up to 6 later on
Your first battles with Wren and Rell are now 2 Pokémon each, like the real games. Leaders always keep their ace
Outnumbered? When a Rival or Leader brings more Pokémon than you have standing, their team is a little lower level
Small teams are now viable, so runs with fewer Pokémon can reach the later Gyms

changelog.title: Fixes from an Automated Playtest
changes: Fixed: a beaten trainer could end up standing in the only gap in a Gym maze and block the Leader. Trainers now walk back to their post after a battle
If you slip past your rival without being spotted, they now stop you at the exit instead of leaving you to hunt for them
Rivals and Gym Leaders now bring as many Pokémon as you have (at least their own team), not always six
Rivals and Leaders only hold Leftovers from your 2nd badge on

changelog.title: Polish: Hideout and Surf
changes: The Tempest Hideout is now a real cave: rock walls, an earth floor, and wild Pokémon anywhere inside
Only Team Tempest in the hideout now, no stray townsfolk
Your SURF ride is bigger and more detailed, and faces the way you travel
Removed stray ledges from the little islands at sea

changelog.title: Phases 2 and 3: Surf and the Eastern Gyms
changes: SURF: beat Leader Sable in Tidalkeep for HM03 SURF, then face any water and press A to ride across it
Fishing: a fisherman gives you the OLD ROD. Face water and press A to cast
Water Pokémon now live in the water: surf or fish for them. Grass is for land Pokémon
Mirror Lake, Hollow Bluffs and Glimmer Coast now have real lakes, plus the open Glimmer Sea to explore
Portmere is no longer the end: SURF across the Stormwake Strait to reach four new towns and Gyms
New Gyms: Juno (Electric) in Voltara City, Bryn (Grass) in Mossgrove Town, Hale (Ice) in Rimefall Town and Corvin (Dragon and Flying) in Aeriepeak City. That makes 8 badges
Track Team Tempest to their hideout in the frozen ridge, where Wren makes a choice
Snow on Frostpine Ridge and in Rimefall, and a dark cave for the hideout
Fixed: items at the end of a side path could sometimes be unreachable

changelog.title: Every Move Animated
changes: All 387 moves now have their own animation, based on the move's name
Bite snaps jaws shut, Flamethrower breathes a stream of fire, Bubble Beam fires a stream of bubbles
Punches, kicks and slaps land fists, boots and palms; claws and slashes leave marks
Rock Slide drops boulders, Earthquake shakes the screen, Fly takes off before it strikes, Sing sends music notes
Elemental moves add their element: Fire Fang bites then burns, Thunder Punch adds lightning
Status moves like Sleep Powder and Thunder Wave now show their own effect too

changelog.title: Attack Animations
changes: Every attack now has a pixel-art effect for its type: flames, bubbles, leaves, lightning, ice, rocks and more
Physical moves lunge at the target; special moves fire a stream across the field
HP bars drain when the hit lands, not before

changelog.title: Cleaner Battles
changes: Your side now shows one Pokémon at a time: whoever is choosing a move, attacking or taking a hit
Your full team stays listed with HP on the right
The opposing team is still all on screen, so you can plan your attacks

changelog.title: Poké Ball Throw
changes: Throwing a Poké Ball is now animated: it arcs in, draws the Pokémon inside, and shakes up to three times
A click means it's caught; if it bursts open, the Pokémon broke free
Catch odds are unchanged

changelog.title: Learning New Moves
changes: A Pokémon that already knows four moves now asks before learning a new one
Pick which move to forget, or choose not to learn it, just like the real games

changelog.title: EXP Share and EXP Bar
changes: New OPTION: EXP SHARE ON (whole party earns EXP) or OFF (only Pokémon that attacked)
Your Pokémon now show an EXP bar under their HP in battle

changelog.title: Phase 1.5: Guided Routes
changes: Routes are now paths through the forest instead of wide open fields, so it's clear where to go
Side paths wind through tall grass to hidden clearings with an item waiting at the end
Tall grass stretches across the main path, and trainers watch it: no more skipping them
Items now include Potions, Super Potions, Antidotes and status heals, not just Poké Balls
Fewer wild encounters in tall grass

changelog.title: Fixes
changes: Roads now line up where towns meet routes (no more step in the path)

changelog.title: Balance: Party Size
changes: Your party holds 6 POKéMON until you earn your 4th badge, then grows to 10
Early rival and Gym battles are now even fights (6 vs 6 at most)
Locked party slots show on the POKéMON screen until they open up
Already have more than 6? You keep them all

changelog.title: Story Phase 1: Storm Clouds
changes: Team Tempest arrives: grunts on Marrow Pass, Hollow Bluffs and Emberflow Delta
Portmere Harbour replaces the unfinished ??? town, with Admin Vesper's scene at the docks
Tidewarden stone tablets on four side areas tell the legend of a guardian beneath the sea
PROF. HAWTHORN calls on your POKéNAV after badges 1, 2 and 4
Story townsfolk in every gym town, and new lines from your rival Wren

changelog.title: The Handheld
changes: The whole game plays on a GBA SP-style handheld: title, intro, overworld, battles and Free Battle
Eight shell colours to choose from in OPTION > FRAME
SELECT opens the map; B, SELECT or START closes it
A FEEDBACK button right on the controller
Phones get a taller screen that shows more of the world
Nearby areas' people stay put when you cross between areas

changelog.title: Pixel-Art Overworld
changes: Trees, ground, water, signs, buildings and interiors redrawn as pixel art
New battle backdrop and platforms
Smooth entrances and exits: no more characters popping in or out
Mom at home heals your party

changelog.title: Playtest Fixes
changes: Anonymous in-game feedback, plus automatic crash reports
Fixed: START sometimes ignored, text highlighting on iPhone, caught Pokémon never getting a turn
Easier first route: early trainers never outnumber you
Clearer multi-Pokémon battles, and signposts at every town exit
